catalyst_rows.indication: Pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) - post-PROSERA regulatory path
catalyst_rows.raw_text: Based on the PROSERA results, the Company plans to request a Type C meeting with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), to occur potentially in June 2026, to discuss the data and potential regulatory paths forward.

extractor_notes.blockers: PROSERA Phase 3 topline was reported in February 2026 (narrowly missed primary endpoint); SERANATA enrollment paused; only forward-dated catalyst is the potential June 2026 Type C FDA meeting. No new clinical readout dates committed.
